name: lingxi
tagline: 灵犀跨境 — open-source community edition of a multilingual customer operations hub for going-global teams
description: lingxi (灵犀跨境) is the open-source community edition of a multilingual customer operations hub built for teams expanding overseas. The repository includes the SaaS application, API layer, and database layer, with multi-tenant registration, login, teams, role-based permissions, token revocation, and audit logging. Telegram and WhatsApp gateway implementations and all production credentials are intentionally excluded from the open scope. It targets cross-border (出海) teams that want auditable, self-deployable customer operations infrastructure rather than vendor lock-in.
highlights: Open community edition of a multilingual customer operations hub
Multi-tenant SaaS layer with roles, token revocation, and audit logs
Deliberately excludes gateway implementations and production credentials from open scope
Built for go-global teams wanting auditable, self-deployable infrastructure
curatorNote: The 'community edition for multilingual customer operations' model is a refreshingly honest open-source strategy — share the core, keep the fragile production gateways private. For cross-border teams it is a genuinely useful self-hostable base.
